title: Surfer Girl

scenes.summary: Fern likes to surf at Bird Rock where there are great waves.
scenes.text: Fern likes to surf at Bird Rock. Bird Rock has the best waves.
scenes.image_prompt: young girl smiling with surfboard near ocean waves at rocky beach, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Fern faces a big wave and must act quickly.
scenes.text: Here is a big wave. Fern has to turn fast.
scenes.image_prompt: girl surfing and quickly turning on a big wave, dynamic ocean scene, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Fern bravely swims toward an even bigger wave.
scenes.text: Here is a bigger wave. Fern swims to meet it.
scenes.image_prompt: girl swimming toward a large wave with surfboard in ocean, bright and fun cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: The biggest wave curls into a tube and Fern rides inside it.
scenes.text: Here comes the biggest wave. The wave curls over and makes a tube. Surfing in the tube is fun!
scenes.image_prompt: girl surfing inside a curling wave tube with splashy water, exciting colorful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Fern wants to surf all day but her dad tells her no.
scenes.text: Fern wants to surf all day. Her dad says, "No way."
scenes.image_prompt: girl holding surfboard talking to her dad on beach at sunset, cheerful cartoon illustration

story: Fern likes to surf at Bird Rock. Bird Rock has the best waves. Here is a big wave. Fern has to turn fast. Here is a bigger wave. Fern swims to meet it. Here comes the biggest wave. The wave curls over and makes a tube. Surfing in the tube is fun! Fern wants to surf all day. Her dad says, "No way."
